name: Abyss at Hand
description:
About This Game

Form an adventuring party on your own or with friends, and set out to defeat this world’s Demon Lord!

The game supports 1 to 4 players. Join your friends as a party of adventurers in another world, where you can explore and fight together!

You will face numerous enemies along the way, but you can wipe them all out!

Overcome challenge after challenge, continue to grow, become legends, and face even stronger foes!

The game has been in development for over a year and is still being developed. Stay tuned!

Add it to your wishlist to hear about future updates as soon as they arrive!

Choose your class and begin your adventure

Abyss at Hand is a top-down 3D action-adventure game.

Choose a Warrior, Archer, or Mage and take on challenges in your own way: fight up close with a sword, shoot enemies from afar with a bow, or destroy them with magic!

Each class has its own basic attack combos and skills. Find the character that suits you and become a master of combat in another world!

Master the rhythm of combat with combos, skills, and dodges

Chain basic attacks with class skills, move and dodge-roll to evade enemy attacks, and look for an opening to strike back.

Keep mana costs and cooldowns in mind when using skills. When facing melee swarms and ranged attacks, adjust your positioning and timing to make the most of your character’s abilities.

Gain experience and loot to grow stronger

Defeat enemies to gain experience and level up, growing stronger as your adventure unfolds.

Obtain various weapons through combat. Weapons come with different qualities and stats, and most also grant passive effects.

Compare weapons and equip the ones that suit you to prepare for the battles ahead.

Explore the path ahead and face powerful foes

Follow the adventure’s paths, fight your way past enemies, and face one powerful foe after another.

Get ready for wild battles unlike anything you have experienced before!

Take on the adventure solo or in local co-op with friends

The game supports 1 to 4 players locally on the same device. Development is ongoing, and I will consider adding online multiplayer in the future. Stay tuned!

If you want to play together online in the meantime, you can use Steam’s Remote Play Together feature.

Adventure alone or have each friend control a character as you explore, fight, and challenge bosses together.

Combine melee, ranged, and magic attacks to overcome the enemies you meet along the way!

About me and this game

Written on November 3, 2026

I’m KuraYH. I’ve been making this game for over a year, and I’m still working on it.

From 2025 to today, I’ve kept working on this game, and now it has finally reached the point of having a Steam store page. That makes me feel both excited and deeply moved.

So I’ll keep doing my best to finish it and make it shine.

If the me from two years ago could see me now, I think they would be deeply moved too.

I think I really did manage to keep going.
